title: [Lean] Verification of binary input preparation, κ=0.000661885549259598
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

A standalone completed Lean 4.21.0 chunk: four modules, 48,221 source bytes, no Mathlib dependency. All 15 added files are under research/lean-binary-input-preparation; no inherited root files or scientific checks change. This chunk is independent of the exact-port interface in #487.

Finite-state machine coverage (universally quantified over finite Boolean inputs):
- Six-state, three-tape reversal with a complete halted configuration, exact Tape.ofWord bits.reverse output, arbitrary spare tape preserved, and elapsed bounds 1 for empty input or 3*length+2 otherwise. Output head is the first bit. Input tape final representation is stated explicitly; original input head restoration is not claimed.
- Fourteen-state, four-tape paired preparation for arbitrary empty or unequal-length x,y with two pristine work tapes. Pads to n=max lengths, reuses the reversal proof twice, and reaches exact MSB-first work words with heads on their right blanks within 6*n+7 transitions. Both full endpoints and numeric values are proved. No extra arbitrary spectator tape is in this paired contract, and n is proof-side length rather than a supplied runtime counter.

Conditional-interface coverage: reusable explicit-tape preparation primitives. Source caller/preconditions/accounting remain to be connected. This does not implement the source single x#y prelude, binary length counter, radix grouping, complete multiplication caller, Plan/ModelFamily/compiler builder, or represented-error budget. Full multiplication/runtime exponent theorem: not established. These standard generic ideas carry no novelty claim; the contribution is the concrete checked implementation and precise endpoint/resource statements.

Explicit author-checked historical project kappa: 330942774629799/500000000000000000 = 0.000661885549259598, source 3b6b66891c0ac888521cf591fe306c6286601d4f. It remains conditional on analytic, uniform-recursion and fixed-tape interfaces. None of these four generic machine modules proves that exponent. AUTHOR_CHECK.json, PROVENANCE.json and evidence preserve this limited attribution and exact certificate.

Exact base: 12a4934d15006e8c10f9b2264f13f8f341be802b. Exact head: edd3102b415df5b9d6f633ac0a4dedcf69c58525. Current main README kappa 0.000723571590007464 is a separate target, not a source-program reconciliation claim for this package.

## Validation

Fresh isolated Linux replay PASS for all four modules:10.2832 compiler seconds,0.00547 shared-slot queue seconds. All four object hashes and18 printed axiom sets match accepted historical checks. Classical.choice is explicitly reported for prepare_run. Independent statement/scope, replay and final15-file package reviews passed, followed by author readback of the final replay wording and kappa context.

Reproduce from package directory: python3 check.py --lean /path/to/lean-4.21.0/bin/lean --build-dir .build

The runner validates exact hashes/import order, starts with fresh objects/no extra library paths, and enforces60-second/4-GiB hard limits with40-second/3.5-GiB review stops. No network or installation step is performed. See README.md and REPLAY_SUMMARY.json.

Local Lean kernel replay is separate from executable scientific checks, exact-head fork CI, upstream CI and maintainer gates. No CI pass is claimed. make verify/gen4-bank-verify were not rerun locally for this additive package. An inherited base verify-joint failure was independently observed at12a4934:joint_dual_compose.py check_sources raises AssertionError:Makefile; no check is weakened here.

Existing PRs were compared using reversal/input-preparation searches; no matching concrete finite-tape Lean chunk was identified. Attribution is retained under Apache-2.0; substantial OpenAI model assistance was used. Draft for review of this completed reusable component.
